originals.citation: Walsh, R. N., Budtz-Olsen, O. E., et al. (1971). Environmentally induced changes in the dimensions of the rat cerebrum. Developmental Psychobiology.
Altman, J., Wallace, R. B., et al. (1968). Behaviorally induced changes in length of cerebrum in rats. Developmental Psychobiology.

quote: In previous reports exposure to 80 or 90 days of environmental complexity induced a significant increase in the length of the rat cerebrum, whereas 30 days' exposure induced changes which failed to reach significant levels.
notes: Full text not accessible. Same title as the authors' 1971 paper, so walsh1971 is the primary original (self-replication); Altman et al. 1968 is the other earlier report of cerebral-length increase and plausibly among the 'previous reports'. DOIs unverified.
